claim: Defines the layer-l disposition direction d_l as the L2-unit-normalized difference between the mean insecure-finetune and mean base-model residual-stream activations, used as a linear probe direction for misalignment.
Defines the layer-l decision threshold tau_l as the midpoint between the projected insecure and base class means on the disposition direction.

Defines the activation-steering intervention that adds a scaled concept vector to the hidden state on every forward pass, where alpha is the steering strength, s a calibrated global norm, and v-hat a unit direction.
